name: Sprint (Scrum)
summary: Backlog, sprint, in progress, review and done, with limits and story cards.

lists.name: Backlog
lists.description: Refined stories waiting for a sprint, most valuable first. Each should have a clear outcome and acceptance criteria before it moves on.

lists.name: Sprint
lists.description: The commitment for this sprint. Nothing new is added mid-sprint without taking something out.

lists.name: In progress
lists.description: Being worked on now, at most 4 cards. Agents: claim one card from Sprint, move it here, and tick tasks off as you go.

lists.name: Review
lists.description: Finished, waiting for review or testing. Keep this short: reviewing beats starting.

lists.name: Done
lists.description: Meets the acceptance criteria and the team's definition of done.

cards.name: As a user, I can reset my password
cards.description:
**As a** registered user
**I want** to reset my password by e-mail
**So that** I can get back in when I forget it.

tasks.name: A reset link is e-mailed within a minute
The link works once and expires after an hour
A weak new password is rejected
Other sessions are signed out after a reset

cards.name: Spike: compare two search libraries
cards.description: Time-boxed investigation. Outcome: a short written recommendation, not production code.

cards.name: Upgrade the build tooling
cards.description: Keep the toolchain current so upgrades stay small.
